scope: Independent read-only static review of backend-owned M4.2 rules/service/repository/0009 migration/import-worker integration and related rule/service tests against sole PRODUCT_DESIGN v3.0.1; no repository files changed by reviewer in this task.

findings.counterexample: An original successful command with an intact own snapshot/decision/receipt history could not replay its ACK after unrelated new material had corrupted metadata/hash, because fresh load_inputs ran before execute_idempotent.
findings.repair: Fresh owner inputs now execute only inside a new operation after strong CAS and current batch/generation checks. Current Policy, workspace ownership and complete immutable history remain ahead of historical ACK replay.

findings.counterexample: An external stop signal arriving during the second actual complete owner read was ignored and the worker published a batch.
findings.repair: Check stopping after the second actual read and again after publish before transaction exit; raise _RefreshStopped to roll back all native changes. This is cooperative cancellation at tested boundaries, not an atomic guarantee against any possible signal after final check.

previously_known_not_new: Rechecked SQL sequence versus embedded sequence, command request hash/applied flag and required applied receipts protections; these were root/owner discoveries and are not attributed to this review.
other_scope: Seven finite reasons use actual exact source/context refs; empty cold import does not invent a need; independent evidence qualification and deterministic incorrect provenance stay owner checked. Original submitted_at drives due time, valid_until makes expired GET stale without writes. Current decision overlay preserves immutable order/IDs; cursor binds workspace/course/limit/batch/position and rejects replaced batch. Commands retain exact idempotency instance and history under strong CAS. Recommendation failure cooldown and one maintenance tick before grading/import avoid starving recommendation refresh under a nonempty import queue. No further reachable blocking defect found in this bounded static scope.
historical_get_integrity_boundary: No new finding: healthy lifecycle archive/invalidation is a verifiable unavailable state whose historical metadata remains stale. Corrupt current metadata/hash makes the current basis uncheckable; the sole spec does not promise a partial successful GET on integrity failure. Fail-closed read preserves stored snapshots and makes no failed/current writes. ACK replay has the separate explicit original-instance guarantee fixed by B1. No proposal to swallow Policy or own frozen-history integrity failures.
remaining_evidence_gap: Static implementation of frozen pagination appears consistent, but inspected Python/E2E tests do not exercise actual server-issued next_cursor, scope/limit/signature isolation or replacement-batch CURSOR_EXPIRED. The frontend has a mocked mismatching-batch test. Root and owner notified to add native pagination acceptance evidence; this is a coverage gap, not a demonstrated implementation defect.
